copy: Strategy's net BTC per share rose 21,631 sats in Q3 2026 in the weekly model. Retiring STRC added 179 of those sats; bitcoin trades took 43. Revaluing at Bitcoin's price added 22,411.
replies: Q3 2026 rows: $1,379.1M of STRC retired; 7,218 BTC bought for $588.1M; 5,553 BTC sold for $348.5M. Each row links its 8-K in data/actions.csv.

The rest of the 21,631: price revaluation +22,411, in-the-money flips +361, common issuance +332, dividends and interest −801, residual −808. The model sums weekly effects, so the parts add to the observed change.

Limits: Q3 is the weeks ending Jul 5 to Sep 30, 2026. Strategy's Q3 10-Q is not filed yet, so nothing is reconciled to its reported quarter. Data and every 8-K link: https://github.com/RahilBhavan/dat-accretion

copy: Holdings can rise while coins per share fall. This illustration adds 10% more coins and 25% more shares. Each share ends up with 12% less. The numbers are made up.
replies: This example uses gross coins. Strategy's Net Bitcoin Per Share instead nets USD assets and debt/preferred claims before dividing by fully diluted shares. Definition: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1050446/000119312526363557/d431748dfwp.htm

dat-accretion applies Strategy's definition to BitMine. BitMine's weekly shares are estimated, not filed counts. Coins per share is one measure; it leaves out price and risk. Method and limits: https://github.com/RahilBhavan/dat-accretion/blob/main/docs/methodology.md

sources.label: Strategy FWP glossary, Net Bitcoin Per Share (2026-08-24)
